title: The Last Platform
story_job: Force Mara to choose between speed and helping a stranded child.

structure.goal: Reach the north platform before the evacuation train departs.
structure.obstacle: Floodwater blocks the direct route and a child is trapped on a kiosk.
structure.tactic: Use a floating bench as a bridge while pulling the child across.
structure.reversal: The medicine case slips into the current.
structure.audience_value_shift: Efficient escape becomes a costly moral commitment.

shared_event: Mara rescues the child and loses control of the medicine case.

acting_direction.mara: Keep the child calm while privately calculating whether the rescue will cost both lives.

entering_state.mara: Dry above the knees; right palm uninjured; medicine case sealed in left hand.
entering_state.environment: Water waist-high at the center aisle, flowing east to west.

geography.screen_direction: Mara advances screen-left to screen-right toward the north platform.
geography.axis: Primary axis runs south entrance to north platforms.

audio_bed: Rain on broken roof, waist-deep current, distant departure alarm.
